subject: Choroid plexus MRI measures tracked later dementia risk
script: From Agewell Brief: Choroid plexus MRI measures tracked later dementia risk. A large UK study finds that MRI measures of the choroid plexus—a structure that makes cerebrospinal fluid—track with later dementia risk. The finding is a signal, not a test. 45,306 UK Biobank participants were followed over time. Larger choroid plexus and lower signal intensity raised risk. Read the full source-linked dispatch and primary study caveats at AgewellBrief.com.
